title: Correlation Summary
description: Closed summary of linking connector observations to optimization trials, produced customer-side. Code identity (function reference, repo-relative file path) is permitted; repository URLs and data identifiers are not. Closed schema: any new field or enum value ships as a new schema_version published alongside this one; consumers dispatch on schema_version.

OpaqueToken.description: Opaque token: prefix tk_ plus 26 lowercase Crockford base32 characters (a random 128-bit value). Minted customer-side from a fresh random 128-bit value per connection; never derived from labels, names or platform identifiers.

agent_function_ref.description: Code identifier of the agent function: module[:qualname]. Module is dotted Python identifiers; qualname is dotted identifiers with optional <locals> segments. Code identity, not content.

agent_file_path.description: Repository-relative POSIX source-file path: segments of letters, digits, '_', '.', '-' separated by '/'; no '.' or '..' segment; must end in .py, .ts, .tsx, .js, .jsx, .mjs, .cjs, .json, .yaml or .yml.
